input.prompt: Installation, authentication, and how to start Claude Code in the terminal
What is Claude Code and the basic terminal command to run it

content.text:
Based on the official Claude Code documentation, here's how to run Claude Code in the terminal:

## Basic Command

```bash
claude
```

Run this in any project directory to start an interactive session.

## Installation

**Prerequisites:**
- A Claude subscription (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise) or Claude Console account with API credits

**Install (pick one):**

**macOS/Linux/WSL:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows PowerShell:**
```powershell
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Windows CMD:**
```batch
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd && del install.cmd
```

(Windows requires Git for Windows to be installed first)

## Authentication

On first run, `claude` will prompt you to log in. Your credentials are stored locally—you won't need to authenticate again.

## Common Usage Patterns

```bash
claude                           # Start interactive session
claude "your task description"   # Run a single task and exit
claude -p "query"                # Quick query, no session
claude -c                        # Continue most recent conversation
claude -r                        # Resume a previous conversation
```

Inside a session, type `/help` for available commands or `/` to see slash commands.

---

**References:**
- [Claude Code Overview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview.md)
- [Quickstart Guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/quickstart.md)
- [CLI Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference.md)
